
'''Ubusuna Shrine''' (産土神社, Ubusuna Jinja).

* [[Ubusuna Shrine (Konohana, Osaka)]] - Located in [[Konohana Ward]], [[:en:Osaka City|Osaka City]], [[Osaka Prefecture]]. [[Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|Former shrine Rank]]: Village shrine.
* [[Ubusuna Shrine (Taisho, Osaka)]] - Located in [[Taisho Ward]], Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture. Former shrine Rank: Village shrine.
* [[Ubusuna Shrine (Hirano, Osaka)]] - Located in [[Nagayoshi Deto]], [[Hirano Ward]], Osaka City. Managed by [[Shiki Nagayoshi Shrines]]<ref>[http://www.shikinagayoshi-jinjya.org/kenmusya.html Shiki Nagayoshi Shrine], [http://www.jalan.net/travel-journal/000047446/], [http://mawarisute.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-182.html]</ref>.
* [[Ubusuna Shrine (Higashi-Osaka)]] - Located in [[Higashi-Osaka City]], Osaka Prefecture.
* [[Ubusuna Shrine (Misaki)]] - Located in [[Misaki Town]], [[:en:Sennan District|Sennan District]], Osaka Prefecture. Former shrine Rank: Village shrine.

* [[Kokawa Ubusuna Shrine]] - Located in [[:en:Kokawa|Kokawa]], [[Kinokawa City]], [[Wakayama Prefecture]]. A subordinate and tutelary shrine of [[Kokawa-dera]].<ref>[http://www.wakayama-jinjacho.or.jp/jdb/sys/user/GetWjtTbl.php?JinjyaNo=3010 Kokawa Ubusuna Shrine]</ref>
